title: UiFormulaCriterion - Data API
description: Represents a filter that helps define component visibility on a Lightning page. This object is available in API version 47.0 and later.

LeftHandSide.description: Represents the field that the filter is based on. For example, AMOUNT.

OperatorId.description: Represents the filter operator. Valid values are: CONTAINS EQUAL GE—greater than or equal GT—greater than LE—less than or equal LT—less than NE—not equal This is a relationship field.

ParentKeyPrefix.description: Represents the three-digit prefix of the parent ID.

RightHandSide.description: Represents the value used to evaluate the component’s visibility. For example, 1000000.

RuleId.description: Represents the formula rule ID. This is a relationship field.

wsdl_segment:

  <restriction base="xsd:string">
    <length value="18"/>
    <pattern value="[a-zA-Z0-9]{18}"/>
  </restriction>
</simpleType>
<complexType name="UiFormulaCriterion">

    <extension base="ens:sObject">
      <sequence>
        <element name="CreatedBy" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="ens:User"/>
        <element name="CreatedById" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="tns:ID"/>
        <element name="CreatedDate" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:dateTime"/>
        <element name="IsDeleted" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:boolean"/>
        <element name="LastModifiedBy" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="ens:User"/>
        <element name="LastModifiedById" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="tns:ID"/>
        <element name="LastModifiedDate" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:dateTime"/>
        <element name="LeftHandSide" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:string"/>
        <element name="OperatorId" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:string"/>
        <element name="ParentKeyPrefix" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:string"/>
        <element name="RightHandSide" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:string"/>
        <element name="Rule" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="ens:UiFormulaRule"/>
        <element name="RuleId" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="tns:ID"/>
        <element name="SystemModstamp" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:dateTime"/>
      </sequence>
    </extension>
  </complexContent>
</complexType>
